ret.requirements: Level 60, exported talents, two-handed main hand, at least 12 equipped items.
ret.defaults: Native Unsealed Wrath default APL. Public upstream Ret buffs and consumables; review defaults.json or exact nativeRequest in the local fight library. Exported talents and professions replace preset choices.

disc-raid.objective: Effective healing plus consumed absorbs; survival first
disc-raid.requirements: Level 60, at least 31 points in Discipline, at least 12 equipped items.
disc-raid.defaults: Declared group, tank or burst assignment; raid support, Distilled Wisdom, Nightfin Soup and Major Mana Potion. Override support explicitly in local scenario.json.
limitations: Stationary assigned workload; not a coupled 40-player raid
No movement, dispels, positioning or competing healers
Post-mitigation damage excludes defensive mitigation utility
Fixed casting priorities are not an optimal-play guarantee
